sources.officialProductEvidence: The official page confirms the QST 94 Lilac product, article reference L49189300+, sizes 156/164/172/180/188 cm, 94 mm waist, intermediate skill level, Freeride Profile, 13.5 m displayed radius, 131-94-117 mm displayed sidecut, Full Poplar Woodcore, Ti Binding Reinforcement, Basalt Superlight Fibers, Fiberglass, Full Sandwich Sidewalls and Cork Damplifier.
sources.seasonEvidence: The current Salomon US and German product pages confirm article L49189300+ but do not print a season label. Tanabe's 2026/27 report places QST 94 in its '25-26 carryover models' section; exact-model retailer pages from SkiEssentials, Sporting Life, and Snow-How label the article/model as 2027 or 2026/27. Archive as a 2026/27 carryover and retain that the official product page omits the season.

limitations: German official-store reference price; not a mainland-China price.
The captured product text does not establish tax treatment, cross-border delivery cost, import charges, or payment conversion cost.

catalogueAndTestReport.evidence: The 2026/27 staff test report places QST 94 under '25-26 carryover models' and lists sidecut, radius, and ski-only mass (1/2 pair) for 156/164/172/180/188 cm. The 188 cm value is 2940 g per ski, which conflicts with the official German page's 3880 g net weight for a pair; do not map the retailer value.

officialGermanChart.weightInterpretation: 德国官方表将重量列为 Nettogewicht，按商品内容仅含雪板，故作为整双净重录入。Tanabe 2026/27 试乘报告（该款列在 25/26 延续款部分）独立列出 156 cm 单只 1520 g、172 cm 单只 1700 g，与官方表 3040 g、3400 g 对应。

skillLevelRegionalDifference.decision: Retain the US-page level and explicitly disclose that Salomon's regional pages use different labels; do not normalize the two terms as if identical.

mappingNotes: The Salomon German official chart is the source of all five per-size dimensions, radii, underfoot lengths, and pair net weights. The Tanabe report agrees on the 156/164/172/180/188 sidecuts and radii; its 188 cm per-ski mass is inconsistent with the official pair net weight and is excluded.
imageRights: The official product image URL is a source reference only; no explicit reuse license verified.
